description: What is in the local imports folder made by import_workouts (~/.suunto-mcp/imported/), from the folder alone: imported count, bySource, bytes, oldest/newest, problems (damaged, foreign or newer record, missing file, size mismatch: never repaired or deleted), incomplete (a file without a record from an interrupted import; importing it again completes it), otherFiles. Local only: no Suunto call, writes nothing, does not create a missing folder.
name: get_import_status
title: Get the local imported-workouts status
